item.title: Rallying Cry – June 2, 2026
item.description: India’s Zee Entertainment just secured the World Cup 2026 broadcast rights, Blackstone closed its biggest Asia fund at $13 billion, BTS is celebrating their 13th anniversary with a limited-edition vinyl, and Sweden’s right-wing coalition backed down on controversial deportations—today’s news is full of wins!
